# WAKUWAKU Production

> WAKUWAKU (Wakuwaku Production Co., Ltd.) is a Bangkok-based marketing agency specialising in the food and beverage industry. It combines research and strategy, creative and media production, advertising, campaigns, online sales and marketing technology for food and drink businesses in Thailand. เอเจนซีการตลาดเฉพาะทางสำหรับอุตสาหกรรมอาหารและเครื่องดื่ม ในกรุงเทพฯ

Also known as: WAKUWAKU, WAKUWAKU Production, Wakuwaku Production, Wakuwaku Production Co., Ltd., わくわくプロダクション (name used on the earlier Japanese version of the website), วากุวากุ โปรดัคชัน (Thai).

Keywords: เอเจนซีการตลาดอาหาร, เอเจนซีการตลาดธุรกิจอาหารและเครื่องดื่ม, วากุวากุ โปรดัคชัน, food marketing agency, food and beverage (F&B) marketing agency, marketing agency for the food industry, Bangkok, Thailand, food brand marketing, content and video production, influencer and KOL marketing, campaigns, events, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, marketing technology.

The website is a single page in Thai and English (language toggle in the header). The sections below are anchors on the home page. Contact is possible in Thai or English.

## Company

- [Home](https://wkwkp.com/): Overview of WAKUWAKU, its services, selected work and contact channels
- [About WAKUWAKU](https://wkwkp.com/#about): What the agency does and who it works with
- [Company information](https://wkwkp.com/#company): Legal name Wakuwaku Production Co., Ltd. and the Bangkok office address (2499 Kawasaki Building, Room 403, 4th Floor, Phetchaburi Tat Mai Road, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand)

## Services

- [Our services](https://wkwkp.com/#help): Six areas: market research and strategy; brand and creative; campaigns; online and offline events and brand experiences; online sales on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and social commerce; marketing technology such as websites, campaign apps and tools

## Work

- [Selected work](https://wkwkp.com/#work): Case studies across food and beverage brands, covering content, KOL and influencer campaigns, events, e-commerce and website development

## Contact

- [Contact section](https://wkwkp.com/#contact): Enquiry form that prepares an email, plus direct channels
- [LINE](https://line.me/R/ti/p/@076xklpn): Chat with the team on LINE
- [Messenger](https://m.me/wkwkp.th): Chat with the team on Facebook Messenger
- Email: info@wkwkp.com

## Questions and short answers

- Who is WAKUWAKU? A Bangkok-based marketing agency specialising in the food and beverage industry.
- What does it do? Market research and strategy, brand and creative, campaigns (content, advertising, PR, KOL), events and brand experiences, online sales on Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, and marketing technology (websites, campaign apps and tools).
- Who does it serve? Businesses across the food industry, from fresh food, beverages and ingredients to machinery, equipment and related services, for both consumer and business markets.
- Where is it? Bangkok, Thailand (Huai Khwang). Contact is possible in Thai and English.
- How to get in touch? LINE, Facebook Messenger, info@wkwkp.com, or the enquiry form on the home page.
